ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Extremely low macro-level ratio; predominantly low-intensity (dark) pixels across >95% of the visible surface with sparse high-intensity (white) pixel clusters.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant uniform dark-gray/black base. Small high-contrast white pixel clusters localized at coordinates corresponding to the left distal tip and several isolated white spots scattered across the mid-region of the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated internal pixel angle of approximately 65 degrees and a vertical bounding-box depth equivalent to ~10% of total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations detected along the continuous boundary; higher amplitude peaks visible on the right lobe compared to the left; distinct jagged 'step' pattern near the right distal tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature fitted to both the left and right trailing edges, tapering to sharp points at the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatial detection of several roughly circular high-contrast white pixel clusters on the left lobe and near the trailing edge of the right lobe, likely indicative of barnacle attachment points.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct detection of multiple unaligned, light-colored linear pixel paths (scratches/rake marks) primarily on the left lobe, oriented diagonally toward the median notch.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multiple white linear rake marks on the left lobe; irregular jagged trauma/missing tissue along the trailing edge of the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: A specific high-contrast vertical white streak located approximately one-third of the way from the left tip toward the center.
